project.title: Native password-bound HTTP MFA enrollment
project.goal: Complete pre-session password-bound setup, one-time backup disclosure and retained React acknowledgement
project.scope: Finite R04/R41/R42 enrollment slice; no product data opener or deployment authority

boundary.responsibility: Password-bound begin, known-commit confirmation and safe one-time recovery-code presentation
boundary.rationale: Unenrolled users must configure MFA without first-factor session authority or losing the one-time disclosure
excludes: Default workspace opener, actual writer/lifetime authority, persistent/global rate, full R41/R42

errors.refused: Strict credential/origin/body/rate refusal; credential/code401; lock429; unknown/operational503 AUTH_UNCONFIRMED

preconditions: Owner supplies actual socket ConnectInfo and lifetime-admitted executor with safe logging/connection retirement
No default product data opener or writer authority; existing migration/release gates remain binding
postconditions: Begin returns only pendingcookie/URI after known commit and never session/backup codes
Confirm returns exact ten codes plus browser session only after known commit; replay cannot redisclose
Native context isolates login and enrollment and preserves budgets across restart
React manual-key setup and escape are usable; code display waits explicit acknowledgement; uncertainty clears old form with no auto retry
external_effects: Trusted owner native transactions alone alter enrollment/factor/session/audit state
Intentional one-time URI/code disclosure; client keeps secrets only transiently in memory

authorization.rationale: Require current password-bound ceremony, known commit before authority/disclosure, stage separation and safe one-time UI acknowledgement.
